sources.use: Project-authored prototype working limits for machined6061-T6 parts. No supplier capability, quote, dimensional guarantee or load approval is claimed.

featureWallBasis: Declared local machined metal ledges only. Thin machined stop is separately braced; strength, chatter, tool access and dimensional inspection remain required. Not an SLA guideline.
clearanceConvention: Nominal one-sided gap. Small bearing gaps require finished bore/shaft dimensions and measurement; not guaranteed by this profile.
headBearingWorkingBasis: Geometric annular-contact filter only, not a supplier torque/load rating.
notes: Prototype engineering allocation only; selected dimensions must be specified on finished-part drawings and accepted by the actual shop.
Material certificate, machining direction, threads, burrs, surface finish, tolerance chain and physical strength/wear/fatigue are separate acceptance tasks.

This6061profile applies only to declared fabricatedmetalparts; custom purchased POM-C lever/cover material and process are recorded separately in the product source contract. Existing SLA profiles and historical hashes remain unchanged.
